meta.name: ENLIGHT Checklist
meta.citation: Spitschan M, Kervezee L, Lok R, McGlashan E, Najjar RP; ENLIGHT Consortium. ENLIGHT: A consensus checklist for reporting laboratory-based studies on the non-visual effects of light in humans. EBioMedicine. 2023;98:104889.
meta.licenseNote: Both official PDFs state CC-BY-NC-ND without a version. The repository also has a GNU GPL v3 root LICENSE. The specific notice in the PDFs is preserved.
meta.idsNote: Item-level IDs are stable wizard identifiers; the official checklist numbers sections only.
meta.essentialCountNote: The paper says nine essential items but marks ten in Table 2 when the separate light-source selection is included. This wizard preserves the nine location rows without a Not applicable checkbox and treats light-source selection separately.

instructions.location: Enter the page, figure, or table number where the information appears in your manuscript.
instructions.notAvailable: Use Not available when the information was not collected, measured, or cannot be provided.
instructions.notApplicable: Use Not applicable only when the item is irrelevant to your study after consulting the Explanation & Elaboration document.
instructions.essential: This item applies to all studies; Not applicable is not offered in the official checklist.
instructions.scope: A reporting checklist for human laboratory studies of non-visual responses to light. It does not assess study quality.

sections.label: A.1.
sections.title: Protocol-level characteristics
sections.description: Describe the setting, timing, and light exposure before the experiment.

sections.label: A.2.
sections.title: Measurement-level characteristics
sections.description: Identify where and how light was measured.

sections.label: A.3.
sections.title: Participant-level characteristics
sections.description: Report relevant participant characteristics and timing.

sections.label: B.1.
sections.title: Light source type(s)
sections.description: Include background illumination and every experimental light source.

sections.label: B.2.
sections.title: Light level characteristics
sections.description: Identify where the light measurements are reported in your manuscript.

sections.label: B.3.
sections.title: Colour characteristics
sections.description: Report the spectral and colour quantities relevant to your sources.

sections.label: B.4.
sections.title: Temporal and spatial characteristics
sections.description: Describe stimulus position, timing, and size.

items.title: Description of experimental setting
items.description: Include room geometry, windows, participant position, and relevant environmental conditions.

items.title: Timeline of experiment (including timing and duration of light)
items.description: Include key study events and the timing and duration of light exposure.

pdf.location: Timeline of experiment including timing and duration of light

items.title: Pre-laboratory sleep-wake/rest-activity behaviour
items.description: Include instructions, inclusion criteria, measurements, and observation periods before participants entered the laboratory.

items.title: Pre-laboratory light exposure
items.description: Include light exposure instructions, controls, and any measurements before laboratory admission.

items.title: Immediate prior light exposure (in laboratory)
items.description: Describe laboratory lighting before the experimental exposure, including dim-light or dark-adaptation conditions.

pdf.location: Immediate prior light exposure in laboratory

items.title: Measurement plane (e.g., horizontal or vertical)
items.description: Specify the measurement plane for the light quantities you report.

pdf.location: Measurement plane eg horizontal or vertical

items.title: Measurement viewpoint and location
items.description: Specify sensor position and direction for each relevant measurement or light condition.

items.title: Type, make and manufacturer of the measurement instrument
items.description: Identify each instrument, its model, and manufacturer.

pdf.location: Type make and manufacturer of the measurement instrument

items.title: Calibration status of the instrument
items.description: Include calibration timing, type, and provider when available.

items.title: Ocular health and functioning
items.description: Include relevant ocular criteria, assessments, and use of glasses or contact lenses.

items.title: Pupil size and/or dilation
items.description: Report pupil measurements or control, including any pharmacological dilation.

items.title: Relative time (e.g. to circadian phase or sleep)
items.description: Describe exposure timing relative to participants’ sleep or circadian phase.

pdf.location: Relative time eg to circadian phase or sleep

items.title: Type, make and manufacturer of the light source
items.description: Identify each source, its model, and manufacturer.

pdf.location: Type make and manufacturer of the light source

items.title: Use of wearable filtering apparatus (e.g., blue-blocking glasses)
items.description: Describe wearable filters and their effects on light amount or spectrum.

pdf.location: Use of wearable filtering apparatus eg blueblocking glasses

items.title: Illuminance (lux) and/or luminance (cd/m²)
items.description: Report photometric light levels for the experimental conditions.

items.title: Spectral irradiance and/or radiance distribution
items.description: Identify the reported wavelength-resolved light measurements.

items.title: α−opic irradiance and/or radiance (including melanopic)
items.description: Report photoreceptor-weighted irradiance or radiance, including melanopic quantities.

items.title: α−opic equivalent daylight illuminance and/or luminance (EDI/EDL, including melanopic)
items.description: Report equivalent D65 daylight quantities, including melanopic values.

items.title: Peak wavelength and bandwidth
items.description: Primarily relevant to monochromatic or narrowband sources; identify peak wavelength and spectral width.

items.title: Colour appearance quantities (any)
items.description: Examples include chromaticity coordinates and correlated colour temperature.

items.title: Colour rendering metrics (any)
items.description: Identify colour-rendering metrics reported for the source, such as the Colour Fidelity Index.

items.title: Location of stimulus and viewing distance
items.description: Specify stimulus position and distance relative to the participant.

items.title: Temporal pattern (including flash frequency and waveform)
items.description: Include recurring timing, flash frequency, waveform, or dynamic dimming and tuning.

pdf.location: Temporal pattern including flash frequency and waveform

items.title: Relative or absolute size of the stimulus
items.description: Report stimulus size or shape, including size relative to the visual field.

pdf.location: Relative or absolute size of the stimulus

lightSources.title: Light source type(s)
lightSources.description: Select all relevant sources, including background room illumination alongside an experimental device.
lightSources.spectrumNote: Select every spectral type used across the study’s sources or conditions.

lightSourceTypes.title: Emissive surfaces including displays (incl. light therapy devices)

notes.lightLevel: Luminance and radiance metrics are mainly relevant for emissive surfaces.
notes.colour: Peak wavelength and bandwidth are most relevant for monochromatic or narrowband light sources.
